dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product lets people copy things it shows them — a command, a key, an address, a color value, a block of code — with one press, and tells them each time, in the same way and for the same length of time, that it was copied.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: The one value a copy button has of its own: how long it shows that the text was copied, or that it could not be. Everything it draws is a Button's, from the Button's tokens.
rules: A copy button copies one given text and confirms it. It does nothing else: an action with another result is a Button.
It is drawn by Button: choose variant and size as for any Button (the quiet icon action is the text variant). It has no colors or measures of its own.
Give label, copiedLabel and failedLabel in the product's language; none has a default.
The confirmation is a time to notice, not a motion: do not shorten it for reduced motion.
Do not show a snackbar as well for a successful copy: the button has said it.

duration.$description: How long the button shows the copied or the failed form before it returns to rest: long enough to be seen by someone looking at where the text will be pasted, short enough that a second copy a moment later is confirmed anew.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A time to notice, not an animation: the motion dial, which speeds or slows animation, must not shorten it.
